boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named OSU locations for studying, making, moving, viewing art, and spending time with campus community resources.

cards.title: Start at the Student Union
cards.subtitle: 301 Student Union · campus services, dining, and events
cards.notes: Use the building map to orient yourself, then pair a practical errand with campus events, dining, or a meeting in the same stop.
cards.short_summary: A central campus building that combines services, events, dining, and gathering space.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU says the Student Union provides campus resources, facilities, services, and conveniences, and hosts diverse campus activities.
cards.access_notes: Check the Union's published hours and building map before visiting.

cards.title: See the OSU Esports Arena
cards.subtitle: Student Union · gaming and production space
cards.notes: Review the arena’s visitor information before going, then use its listed PCs and production features for a planned gaming or media session.
cards.short_summary: A 1,690-square-foot Student Union arena with PCs, a Twitch station, and a green screen.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU describes the arena as having 40 high-powered PCs, a Twitch station, a green screen, and learning partnerships tied to esports.
cards.source_title: OSU Esports Arena | Oklahoma State University
cards.access_notes: Confirm current access procedures and availability with OSU Esports.

cards.title: Set up at Edmon Low Library
cards.subtitle: Campus library · study rooms and research help
cards.notes: Choose a study-room option or research service from the library site, and check the daily hours before building your work session.
cards.short_summary: OSU’s main library offers study rooms, research support, collections, and creation services.
cards.evidence_claim: The library lists study rooms, research services, resources, and library hours for Edmon Low Library.
cards.source_title: Edmon Low Library and Branch Libraries
cards.access_notes: Study rooms may require reservations; consult the library’s current room and hours pages.

cards.title: Make something in Heritage Arts Studio
cards.subtitle: Edmon Low Library, first floor · textile and sewing equipment
cards.notes: Reserve the first-floor studio and complete any required training before bringing a creative or course-related textile project to work on.
cards.short_summary: A reservable library studio supporting creative and academic textile work.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU Libraries says the Heritage Arts Studio provides sewing and textile-arts equipment and can be reserved by OSU students, staff, and faculty.
cards.source_title: Edmon Low Library and Branch Libraries
cards.access_notes: Reservations and training are required; eligibility is stated for OSU students, staff, and faculty.

cards.title: Take an art break at OSU Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: 720 S. Husband Street · exhibitions and programs
cards.notes: Check the active exhibition and Tuesday–Saturday hours, then give yourself time to look through the galleries without rushing between classes.
cards.short_summary: A Stillwater museum presenting exhibitions, programs, and public art connections.
cards.evidence_claim: The OSU Museum of Art states that admission to its exhibitions, events, and programs is always free.
cards.source_title: OSU Museum of Art | Oklahoma State University
cards.access_notes: Published hours are Tuesday–Saturday, 11 a.m.–4 p.m.; verify holiday or business-hour changes before visiting.

cards.title: Walk through The Botanic Garden at OSU
cards.subtitle: OSU Stillwater · gardens and horticulture displays
cards.notes: Use the garden’s current visitor guidance to plan a slower outdoor stop, and keep to designated areas while viewing seasonal plant displays.
cards.short_summary: An OSU garden site connecting horticulture, public learning, and outdoor exploration.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU maintains The Botanic Garden at OSU as a university garden and visitor resource.
cards.access_notes: Consult the garden’s visitor information for current access details and event-specific requirements.

cards.title: Pause beside Theta Pond
cards.subtitle: Between the Student Union and Greek Life · pond and footbridge
cards.notes: Take a walk or study break along the pond, photograph the bridges and fountains, and leave wildlife and water conditions undisturbed.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus pond used for walking, studying, photos, and observing ducks.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU Facilities Management identifies Theta Pond as a place students and visitors use for studying, walking, jogging, photos, and watching ducks.
cards.source_title: Theta Pond | Oklahoma State University Facilities Management
cards.access_notes: Follow posted wildlife guidance; OSU asks visitors not to introduce toxic objects into the pond.

cards.title: Move at the Colvin
cards.subtitle: 101 Colvin Center · recreation and fitness facilities
cards.notes: Check facility hours and membership eligibility, then choose a listed activity area such as the track, courts, pool, or fitness spaces.
cards.short_summary: A recreation center with courts, fitness areas, aquatics, an indoor track, and activity spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU lists courts, aquatics, a four-lane indoor track, fitness areas, lockers, and other recreation facilities at the Colvin.
cards.source_title: Colvin Recreation Center | Oklahoma State University
cards.access_notes: Access and use depend on current memberships, facility hours, and activity-area rules.

cards.title: Climb at the Colvin wall
cards.subtitle: Colvin Recreation Center · climbing and bouldering
cards.notes: Make a climbing reservation or ask Outdoor Adventure about belay instruction before arriving, especially if you need staff or equipment support.
cards.short_summary: A 25-foot climbing wall and bouldering area operated through OSU Outdoor Adventure.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU lists a 25-foot climbing wall and bouldering walls at the Colvin, with reservations and belay-class information through Outdoor Adventure.
cards.access_notes: Reservations, staff availability, and applicable fees should be confirmed with Outdoor Adventure.

cards.title: Plan a Challenge Course session
cards.subtitle: 1625 N. Western Road · Outdoor Adventure
cards.notes: Contact Outdoor Adventure to reserve a group session, then use the course’s documented games, obstacles, and problem-solving activities as a team activity.
cards.short_summary: A reservable Outdoor Adventure course for physical and mental group challenges.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU describes its Outdoor Adventure Challenge Course as a series of games, obstacles, and problem-solving activities and provides reservation contact details.
cards.access_notes: Reservations are required; published group rates and participant requirements apply.
